TEAM_MULTISIG().notice: Team multisig allowed to trigger admin methods.

pauseAuthContract().notice: FluidPauseAuth main contract. Set once by multisig, then permanently locked.

pauseDex(uint256,bool,bool).notice: Pauses a DEX at the Liquidity layer. Returns event data (bools for supply/borrow + skip flags).

pauseTokens(address[]).notice: Pauses tokens at the Liquidity layer. Returns (paused tokens, skipped tokens).

pauseUser(address,address[],address[]).notice: Pauses a user at the Liquidity layer (pass-through).

pauseVault(uint256,bool,bool).notice: Pauses a vault at the Liquidity layer. Returns event data (bools for supply/borrow + skip flags).

setPauseAuthContract(address).notice: Sets the FluidPauseAuth main contract address. Can only be called once (permanently locked after).

unpauseDex(uint256,bool,bool).notice: Unpauses a DEX at the Liquidity layer. Returns event data.

unpauseTokens(address[]).notice: Unpauses tokens at the Liquidity layer. Returns (unpaused tokens, skipped tokens).

unpauseUser(address,address[],address[]).notice: Unpauses a user at the Liquidity layer (pass-through).

unpauseVault(uint256,bool,bool).notice: Unpauses a vault at the Liquidity layer. Returns event data.

userdoc.notice: Executes pause/unpause operations at the Fluid Liquidity layer. Callable only by the main FluidPauseAuth          contract. Does NOT emit operational events — the main contract handles all event emission based on return values.
